name: @cloudflare/workers-response-store
description: An R2-backed programmatic response store for Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build:examples: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config example/service-binding/wrangler.cache.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/service-cache && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config example/service-binding/wrangler.user.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/service-user
scripts.build:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker
scripts.build:service-workers: npm run build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config example/service-binding/wrangler.cache.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/service-cache && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config example/service-binding/wrangler.user.jsonc --outdir ../../dist/service-user
scripts.check: vp check src example tests README.md package.json tsconfig.json vite.config.ts vitest.config.ts wrangler.jsonc && tsc --noEmit
scripts.deploy:service: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config example/service-binding/wrangler.cache.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config example/service-binding/wrangler.user.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run build:examples && vitest run tests/e2e.test.ts tests/service-binding-e2e.test.ts
